description: [STAGE 3: SYNTAX & STACKS] Alias of basecoat_component_syntax. Retrieve copy-pasteable Basecoat component markup with FSM state variants.

component.description: Component name or alias to retrieve canonical FSM-bound syntax for (e.g. "dialog", "tabs", "button", "input", "select", "metric-card", "data-table", "sidebar-shell", "field", "field-group").

componentId.description: Alternative identifier alias for the component.

environment.description: Target output environment: "html", "astro", "react", "vue", or "svelte". Defaults to "html".

icon.description: Verified Lucide action icon to inject with canonical data-icon="inline-start|inline-end" positioning.

id.description: Alternative identifier alias for the component (matches component argument).

name.description: Alternative identifier alias for the component.

orientation.description: Spatial orientation: "vertical" (standard stacked), "horizontal" (grid 2-column for settings), or "inline" (checkbox/switch/radio).

state.description: Target interactive state variant to bind to markup: "default", "active", "loading", "disabled", "open", "closed", "invalid", or "open/closed".

name: get_component_syntax
